name: spreadsheetSetRepeatingColumns
description: Sets columns that repeat on every printed page.

params.name: columns
params.description: Range of columns to repeat, such as A:B.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Implemented with the _xlnm.Print_Titles defined name. Member form: setRepeatingColumns(columns).

examples.title: Repeat header columns when printing
examples.description: Columns A through B repeat on every printed page.
